channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit: how it works and what bookings count
item.description: The Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit is up to $100 per account year, up from $50 in June 2026, for prepaid stays booked through Chase Travel.

item.title: What does Amex Platinum cell phone protection cover, and what is the deductible?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers a stolen or damaged phone up to $800 per claim after a $50 deductible, twice a year, if the phone bill is paid with the card.

item.title: Amex Platinum and golf: does the card do anything for golfers?
item.description: The US American Express Platinum has no free rounds, green fee credit or tee time priority. Its hotel credit and lounges can help a golf trip.

item.title: How does Rakuten in-store cash back work, and which cards can you link?
item.description: Link a Visa, Mastercard or Amex card, add the store's offer before you shop, then pay in the store with that card. No receipt upload.

item.title: Rakuten sign-up bonus: how the bonus from a friend's link works and what makes it fail
item.description: The Rakuten sign-up bonus from a friend's link needs $50 of purchases that earn cash back within 90 days. It is paid on the next payment date.

item.title: Rakuten on Black Friday 2026: how cash back works and which rates are raised
item.description: Rakuten works on Black Friday as on any day, but store rates move daily. Activate before filling the cart; payment comes in February or May 2027.

item.title: Rakuten order not showing up or cash back missing: what causes it and how do you claim it?
item.description: If a Rakuten order is not showing after 48 hours, check the store's exclusions, then file the Missing Cash Back form within 90 days.

item.title: When does Rakuten pay you, and when is the next payout?
item.description: Rakuten pays on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15. The next payout is February 15, 2027, if you have about $5 confirmed.

item.title: Do premium credit cards offer golf travel packages as well as tee-time bookings?
item.description: Mostly tee-time help. Amex Platinum and Sapphire Reserve list no packaged golf trips; Mastercard's Priceless site lists some, sold by a tour operator.

item.title: Does the Amex Gold Card have cell phone protection?
item.description: No. The consumer Amex Gold Card is not on Amex's list of cards with cell phone protection. It has 90-day purchase protection instead.

item.title: Can you stack Rakuten cash back with Target Circle offers and the Target Circle Card 5%?
item.description: Yes for the Circle Card 5% and automatic Circle deals, on categories that earn. Coupon codes not listed on Rakuten void the cash back.

item.title: What does Rakuten do for Cyber Monday 2026, and how is it different from Black Friday?
item.description: Cyber Monday is November 30, 2026. Rakuten lists raised store rates, but none for the day itself has been published. Earning works as on any day.

item.title: Can you take the Rakuten sign-up bonus as Amex points instead of cash?
item.description: Rakuten's own pages say a welcome bonus can be paid as Membership Rewards points. Two travel sites say the bonus from a friend's link stays cash.

item.title: How long does a Rakuten purchase take to show up in your account?
item.description: Rakuten says a new order typically shows within 24 to 48 hours. Travel can take until after the trip. Its terms give 90 days to report a miss.

item.title: How do you link a credit card to Rakuten for in-store cash back, and which cards work?
item.description: Open Linked Cards in your Rakuten account and add a Visa, Mastercard or Amex card. Then add each store's offer before you pay with that card.

item.title: How does Rakuten work, step by step?
item.description: You click through Rakuten to a store and buy. The store pays Rakuten a commission, and Rakuten passes part of it to you four times a year.

item.title: How do you switch Rakuten from cash back to Amex points, and can you switch back?
item.description: Change the payment method in Account Settings and link your Membership Rewards login. Sources disagree on whether you can switch back.

item.title: When is the Amex Platinum annual fee charged, and can you get it refunded?
item.description: The $895 fee is reported to post on the first statement. Amex refunds it only if you close within 30 days after that statement's closing date.

item.title: Does the Amex Platinum charge foreign transaction fees, and how well does it work abroad?
item.description: The Amex Platinum has no foreign transaction fee, but Amex is taken in fewer places abroad than Visa or Mastercard, and cash from an ATM is costly.

item.title: What credit score do you need for the Chase Sapphire Preferred?
item.description: Chase publishes no minimum score for the Sapphire Preferred. Named sources report 670 to 700 and up, and the score is only one of several checks.

item.title: How does the Chase Sapphire Reserve StubHub credit work, and what counts?
item.description: The Reserve pays back up to $150 per half-year on StubHub and viagogo tickets through 2027, after a one-time activation. Unused credit does not roll over.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Dick's Sporting Goods, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 9% on November 22, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Gift cards, warranties, services, three brands and bulk orders are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Old Navy, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 2% on November 22, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, Joseph Altuzarra items and the part paid with reward points are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Chewy, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 4% on November 22, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Prescriptions, flea and tick products, gift cards and repeat Autoship orders are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Wayfair, and what is excluded?
item.description: Not on the day checked. On November 22, 2026, Rakuten's Wayfair page showed No Cash Back, with no rate, terms or exclusions.

item.title: What are the Sapphire Reserve credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?
item.description: The Reserve lists about $2,400 a year in credits, but most people would use $300 to $900 of it. Add up your own number against the $795 fee.

item.title: What are the Amex Platinum credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?
item.description: On paper the 11 main Amex Platinum credits total $2,994 a year. Your real number is only the ones you would have paid for anyway.

item.title: Is the Amex Platinum referral offer higher or lower than the public offer?
item.description: It can be higher, lower or the same. Amex sets an offer for each applicant, so compare the number each route shows you before you accept.

item.title: How do Amex Platinum purchase protection, return protection and extended warranty work?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers new items for 90 days up to $10,000, refunds refused returns up to $300 an item, and adds up to a year of warranty.

item.title: What travel insurance does the Amex Platinum include, and what does it leave out?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers trip delay up to $500, trip cancellation up to $10,000 and lost bags up to $3,000 a person. It does not pay medical bills.
